hypotheses.V0_agreement_route_predicts_auxiliaries: On held-out FineWeb matches, the agreement-derived route has next-token auxiliary rate at least 0.15 and at least three times the pooled other-route rate.
hypotheses.V1_ioi_route_is_local_name_valued_withou: The held-out IOI-derived route has distance-at-most-two rate at least 0.60, capitalized direct-output fraction at least 0.60, and source-echo rate at most 0.10.
hypotheses.V2_capital_route_is_source_linked_entity: The held-out capital-derived route has source-echo rate at least 0.70 and capitalized direct-output fraction at least 0.50.
hypotheses.V3_repetition_route_is_long_range_copy: Both held-out repetition roles have source-echo rate at least 0.70, literal source-equals-next rate at least 0.30, and median distance at least 4.
hypotheses.V4_semantic_profiles_transfer: The discovery and held-out vectors of auxiliary rate, locality, source echo, capitalization, copy rate, and normalized median distance have cosine at least 0.95 for every route role.
